{{Top|leg}}
'''Noga Mak'tu''', whose name meant "Mother of Dianogas," was a mythical [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] that was said to live in the [[Jatoon Sach'a]], a massive [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vodran]]. She was said to be the largest dianoga to ever live by a factor of ten.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
